content:
maya: RFC follow-up: let's pull locality/regional weighting into a small pluggable scorer so router and policy changes don't collide.
devon: Agreed. Current split (router has region bias, DSL has cost/latency) is painful.
ron: Telemetry emission split too. we need a single snapshot shape for scoring.
maya: Proposal: LocalityScorer interface: score(request_features, telemetry_snapshot, constraints) -> ordered [(route,score,hints)]. pure, side-effect free. pluggable via feature-flag.
priya: Tenant pins/overrides: include constraints in input so scorer only returns compatible routes; router keeps admission control.
devon: Migration: policy-compiler emits scorer-config from DSL rules (e.g., weights for latency/cost/region). keeps backwards compatibility.
ron: Telemetry minimal fields: latency_p95_ms, cost_est_usd, warm_pool_size, probe_age_ms. add explain hints in scorer output for UI.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary window scheduled 02:00-03:00 UTC for scorer.v1.
priya: Perf note: keep fast-path <200us. do progressive scoring: cheap proxy pass, optional hedging pass for close calls.
maya: Fail-safes: scorer timeout -> fallback to legacy routing; metrics: scorer.latency_ms, scorer.timeout, scorer.fallback_count.
devon: I'll prototype compiler translator and a minimal wasm shim. ron/priya will review telemetry and rollout checklist.
maya: I'll open the RFC follow-up with interface and migration steps. tagging @devon @ron @priya. Thanks! :thumbsup:
